behaviors.description: Force removal of files used by an uninstalled but still-running app.
behaviors.preconditions: Independent installed A app/runtime and a live holding sandbox.
behaviors.expected: Ordinary uninstall retains files in the running sandbox; force-remove deletes them. Both remove the app ref while preserving the exact runtime.

mappings.rationale: Actual sandbox file visibility distinguishes retained in-use data from forced removal, without assuming deployment-directory layout.

surface_assertions.rationale: Forced uninstall deletes payload entries that ordinary uninstall preserves for a running instance.
